title: Usable agent context bounded by prefill activation memory, not KV cache size

bf458efb.outcome: sealed; canary cleared; blocked on memory floor at C2T14

arithmetic_tension.statement: A tighter context cap reached lower free memory (7000 cap -> 27 MB free vs uncapped 9114 -> 70 MB crash). KV at 7000 tokens is ~516 MB against a ~2.6 GB model — that alone does not explain 27 MB free from a ~2.3 GB starting point.
arithmetic_tension.implication: Prefill activation memory is the likely consumer; C2g instruments RSS/free during generate to test linear vs superlinear scaling with context.

chunked_prefill_cpu.note: No CPU equivalent of NPUW_LLM_PREFILL_CHUNK_SIZE on the stateful LLMPipeline path used by LocalOpenVinoBackend.

finding: On this stack, usable agent context is bounded by prefill activation memory, not by KV cache size. Cap-lowering (C2g: 5000) treats the symptom; without chunked prefill on CPU, activation pressure remains the practical ceiling.
